content: भिक्षुः [भिक्ष्-उन्] .²1 A beggar, mendicant in general; भिक्षां च भिक्षवे दद्यात् <ls>Ms. 3. 94</ls>. .²2 A religious mendicant, a Brāhmaṇa in the fourth order of his religious life (when he quits his house and family and lives only on alms), a {%Sannyāsin%}. .²3 The fourth order or stage in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa (संन्यास). .²4 A Buddhist mendicant.
